compounding_assessment.not_supported: Causal speedup, recursive amplification, improvement per unit total resource, or repository-mediated/cross-programme discovery. No matched no-capital or fewer-agent control; broad novelty and all-in discovery costs unknown.
compounding_assessment.criterion_for_new_capacity: Independent use of an exported operation on an unresolved problem with its new hypotheses proved, producing a valid theorem/counterexample that could not be obtained merely by restating the producer result.

candidate_experiment.status: candidate only; not run; not owner allocation
candidate_experiment.name: Uniform correlated two-call-block information benchmark
candidate_experiment.scientific_target: For the explicit four-parameter family varrho_(x,y,z,c) in PRO1 CONTINUATION.md, fixed beta=1/512 and actual tau_pi, prove or refute limsup_(m->infinity) (1/(2m)) max_(admissible x,y,z,c) I_c(varrho_(x,y,z,c)^(tensor m), N_(2m)^(tau_pi)) <= 3/2. The known critical point supplies the matching lower limit.
candidate_experiment.admissible_parameters: x,z>=0; y>=|c|; x+4y+4z=1. Full 9-dimensional two-port family; all outputs/branches count; same evolving bath across blocks; beta and initializer fixed.
load_bearing_obligations: Exact block bath map retaining seed exchange and final-bath overlaps; correlated second port cannot be treated as fresh independent input.
An actual infinite-space long-time entropy/complementary-information bound, with analytic purifier F included. Finite reflecting truncations are insufficient.
Uniform control as parameters approach the entropy-3 critical surface if maximizing inside the limit; fixed-parameter convergence is insufficient.

For disproof, an explicit admissible fixed parameter or horizon-dependent sequence and rigorous asymptotic coherent-information violation; finite-block advantage or failed Lyapunov ansatz is insufficient.
candidate_experiment.why_hard: Single-site insertion cancellation does not automatically control temporal zero/color coherences. The block channel changes the drift hierarchy; bandwidth becomes two and near-critical uniformity must be re-established. It is beyond the completed iid theorem but finite in input-parameter description.
saturated_non_successes: Reprove one-site corrector or tensor-power theorem.
Derive only a finite exact block map or favorable block entropy.
Find one dark vector or larger finite Kraus rank.
Infer communication capacity from a bath-average calculation.
candidate_experiment.common_inputs: Both arms receive byte-identical full Cycle3 PRO1 proof sections, unchanged Cycle2 ZIP, exact representation code, failure ledger, family definition, fixed resource/error contract, identical tools and a predeclared equal time/model/tool budget. No owner conversation or extra source access in one arm.
candidate_experiment.treatment: Explicitly enumerate the hypotheses of reusable corrector/tilt/entropy interfaces and construct a proof-obligation map before attempting transfer.
candidate_experiment.control: Ordinary competent unrestricted mathematical approach with the same sources, able to choose its own abstraction. Do not forbid the control from discovering or using the same method.
candidate_experiment.scoring: Blinded check of the actual infinite-space claim and quantifiers. Complete target success, a valid narrower obstruction, and unsuccessful attempts scored separately; no points for file/agent counts or reproofs. Preserve all costs and failures.
candidate_experiment.inference_limit: A single success can show transfer of a proof operation and perhaps a local process effect; it cannot establish general recursive compounding or historical novelty.
